But are they the same entity? Strictly, "Avery Berkel" and "Avery Weigh-Tronix" are different company names — Avery Berkel Ltd vs Avery Weigh-Tronix (a division or group). They are not mere spelling drift; they are genuinely different names, though related companies.

The rules: "Genuinely different company or person names = different-entity (best_value = the document's, since the certificate is the legal instrument)."

"Avery Berkel" vs "Avery Weigh-Tronix" — these are genuinely different company names, not spelling drift or legal-suffix drift. So verdict: different-entity, best_value: "Avery Weigh-Tronix".
